unit: One source-located comparative series. Repeated stations, levels, observables and exposures can share a run. Record groups are descriptive and overlap.
scope: These are all-regime documentary counts by type. A strict incompressible smooth-wall success or failure fraction is not estimated. Design labels describe the identified comparison, not all calculations a paper could have run.

contested.P09: Reconstruction of near-wall velocity extends the prescribed-input category beyond a named traction or stress estimator.
contested.N147: Invited review. Figs. 4–5 trace to Kalitzin et al. 2005, especially Figs. 7, 18–19. Exclude from counts of new primary calculations. Exact redraw/recomputation undocumented.
contested.N400: Whole-pipe temporal forecast with a wall-shear loss, without a distinct deployed wall law. Relevant only under a broader estimator definition.
contested.N635: The adjoint wall treatment primarily estimates shape sensitivities. Separate the primal wall treatment and documentary comparison from independent physical validation.

excluded.P10: No active wall law or tested wall estimator.
excluded.P28: Decomposes observed fluctuations, no tested wall flux mapping; retain as adjacent structure evidence.
excluded.N008: Real wall-boundary comparison, outside turbulent population.
excluded.N144: Reconstructs an outer velocity field; no near-wall treatment, stress estimator or imposed flux assessed.

constitutive_constraint.rule: A stated mathematical restriction on the wall mapping, or a paired observation capable of excluding that restriction at its actual inputs and filter. A structural restriction counts as a formulation, separately from any observed violation.

baseline_availability.meaning: Every eligible coupled LES/RANS series is at risk of lacking a within-setting wall-treatment alternative, including otherwise eligible single-treatment and grid-refinement series. Multiple baselines or controls in a series need observable-specific inspection in source_dispositions.json. The categories describe the principal comparison, and never assign an error direction to an absent baseline.

selection_sensitivity.scope: Sensitivity to requiring independence of fitting and method selection in the listed extrapolations. Each positive entry applies only to the fixed, pre-specified mapping and target stated. The possible additions are an identified sensitivity set. Other inherited or unreported calibration histories remain uncertified, so the upper number is not an archive-wide bound.

second_reading.scope: Agreement measures how reproducibly the labels are assigned inside the 115-work collection. It says nothing about whether the collection represents the literature.

status_by_type.constitutive_constraint: not quotable until repaired and re-read
status_by_type.controlled_wall_change: not quotable until repaired and re-read

second_reading.use: Counts for a type whose status is not quotable are first-reading counts. Do not quote them. Series counts depend on how finely a paper is split and are not reproducible between readings; quote works.
